note: Benton County Conservation recreation area on the Cedar River in northeastern Benton County, reached by gravel. The electric sites are strung along one wooded lane east of the boat ramp, with an open-air shelter, playground and a hiking loop. Hunting is allowed in the unmaintained parts of the property Sept 15 - May 15, not in the campground. --Claude
